title: The Young Men Go Out from Samaria
reflectionText: Ahab heard an overwhelming demand, consulted the elders, and refused the second command. Then a prophet named who would lead against the great multitude, and the smaller force went out. What do the counsel, the mustering, and the ordered advance show before the Syrians fled?
editorialNotes: Packet 018 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within 1 Kings 20:1-21, preserving Ben Hadad’s siege and demands, Ahab’s consultation and refusal, the exchanged messages, the prophet’s word, the mustering of the smaller force, and the Syrian flight.
